name: player_process_pending_pickup_contacts
description: Player::ProcessPendingPickupContacts gates pickup collection to the local active player and dispatches each passing pending pickup contact to Pickup::OnCollected.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player/Pickup contact-processing cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x424210 validates the local-save-state gate, lifecycle states 4 and 5 early exits, pickupQueue head traversal, PassesCollectionTest predicate call, Pickup::OnCollected dispatch with contact->hit.node and saveState, and next-contact iteration.

The native smoke builds a clear pickup contact queue for the local player and verifies that ProcessPendingPickupContacts reaches Pickup::OnCollected and applies the pickup effect while preserving the pending queue node.
